nodes.summary: For a knot $K$ with parametrization $\gamma$ and real numbers $s$ and $t$, the distortion ratio of $K$ at $s$ and $t$ is the intrinsic distance between $s$ and $t$ along $K$ divided by the Euclidean distance $\lVert \gamma(s) - \gamma(t) \rVert$ in $\mathbb{R}^3$, where division by $0$ gives $0$.
nodes.title: Distortion ratio

nodes.summary: For a knot $K$, the distortion of $K$ is the supremum in the extended nonnegative reals $[0, \infty]$ of the distortion ratios of $K$ at $s$ and $t$, taken over all distinct parameters $s \ne t$ in the half-open interval $[0, 2\pi)$.
nodes.title: Distortion of a knot

nodes.summary: For a knot $K$ and real numbers $s$ and $t$, let $\ell$ be the arc length of $K$ between the parameters $s$ and $t$, and let $L$ be the total arc length of $K$. The intrinsic distance between $s$ and $t$ is $\min(\ell, L - \ell)$. When $s$ and $t$ lie in one closed interval of length $2\pi$, this is the length of the shorter of the two arcs of $K$ joining the points with parameters $s$ and $t$.
nodes.title: Intrinsic distance on a knot

nodes.summary: For a knot $K$ with parametrization $\gamma$ and real numbers $s$ and $t$, the arc length of $K$ between $s$ and $t$ is $\left| \int_s^t \lVert \gamma'(u) \rVert \, du \right|$, the length of the arc that $\gamma$ traces between the parameters $s$ and $t$. It does not depend on the order of $s$ and $t$.
nodes.title: Arc length between two parameters

nodes.summary: Let $p$ and $q$ be coprime positive integers, let $T_{p,q}$ be the standard $(p, q)$-torus curve, and let $K$ be a knot with parametrization $\gamma$. Suppose there are an ambient isotopy $H$ of $\mathbb{R}^3$, with time-one map $H_1$, and a strictly increasing diffeomorphism $\sigma$ of $\mathbb{R}$ with $\sigma(t + 2\pi) = \sigma(t) + 2\pi$ for all real $t$, such that $H_1(\gamma(t)) = T_{p,q}(\sigma(t))$ for…
nodes.title: Pardon's lower bound for the distortion of torus knots

nodes.summary: For a knot $K$ with parametrization $\gamma$ and a real number $t$, the speed of $K$ at $t$ is the Euclidean norm $\lVert \gamma'(t) \rVert$ of the derivative of $\gamma$ at $t$.
nodes.title: Speed of a knot

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $p$ and $q$, the standard $(p, q)$-torus curve is the map $\mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}^3$ sending $t$ to $((2 + \cos qt) \cos pt,\ (2 + \cos qt) \sin pt,\ \sin qt)$. It lies on the torus of revolution about the $z$-axis with major radius $2$ and minor radius $1$, and as $t$ runs over $[0, 2\pi]$ it winds $p$ times around the $z$-axis and $q$ times around the core circle of the torus.
nodes.title: Standard torus curve

nodes.summary: For a knot $K$ with parametrization $\gamma$, the total arc length of $K$ is the arc length of $K$ between the parameters $0$ and $2\pi$, namely $\left| \int_0^{2\pi} \lVert \gamma'(u) \rVert \, du \right|$.
nodes.title: Total arc length of a knot

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
